head: e6599548bcddf755e2d5f51edde4318e32705ebc
claim: A consumer app can install the shipped accounts package, link an account with the offline stand-in, and receive an answer.

steps.start: a fresh consumer app with no package installed and no account linked
steps: install the shipped @byokit/accounts package into the app
the app links a ChatGPT account by device code: it shows a code and the person approves it
the app reads the account status
the app asks the provider a question and prints the answer it gets back
steps.result: the installed package answers: "ChatGPT is connected." and the answer "You said: Plan my day"

verdicts.seen: I read all 13 lines of the single capture. Header: "package under test: @byokit/accounts@0.35.0", "installed from: ...byokit-accounts-0.35.0.tgz (npm pack of packages/accounts)", "provider: the kit's own stand-in for OpenAI on 127.0.0.1 (no account, no key, no network)", "run: node consumer.mjs (exit 0)". Output: "sign-in: waiting code MOCK-10001", "status: ChatGPT is connected.", "streamed: You said: Plan my day", "answer: You said: Plan my day". The last two lines ("not offered: Error: AI account not offered here", "no account: ResponseError: ChatGPT isn't signed in yet.") are labelled negative-path checks and the run exited 0, so they do not contradict the outcome. Install, link via offline stand-in, and answer are all shown.
